nodes.name: Triethanolamine-assisted Automated Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Synthesis was conducted using a triethanolamine-assisted route based on a modified NiFe LDH method involving urea decomposition. Five metal salts (cobalt(II) nitrate hexahydrate, nickel(II) nitrate hexahydrate, iron(III) nitrate nonahydrate, ammonium molybdate (para) tetrahydrate, and ammonium tungsten oxide hydrate) were used as precursors. Automated synthesis on a Lissy Chemical Workstation involved pre-programmed pipetting, shaking, and heating at 95 °C in an aqueous medium. Urea was included for decomposition to neutralize charge/assist LDH formation.

nodes.source_text: A wet-chemistry approach based on NiFe LDH synthesis39 was adopted in this work. This triethanolamine-assisted route is selected for its mild reaction conditions of 95 °C in aqueous medium... urea decomposition to neutralize the positive charge generated by Fe3+ substitution

nodes.name: Electrode Fabrication
nodes.procedure: The synthesized catalyst was air-brushed onto both sides of 0.3 mm Ni foams. Electrode areas measuring 1 x 1 cm were isolated using epoxy resin.

nodes.description: Electrochemical OER/HER performance in alkaline electrolyte on Glassy Carbon Electrode
nodes.source_text: The synthesized catalysts were then re-dispersed, drop-casted onto glassy carbon electrodes, and tested in a typical three-electrode rotating disc set-up in 1 M potassium hydroxide electrolyte... LSV measurement at 10 mV s−1... NN-12 has ηOER and ηHER values of 277.5 mV and 335.4 mV respectively... NN-12 also exhibits significantly lower charge transfer resistance (Rct) than the original NiFe LDH.

nodes.description: Overall water splitting stability and performance on Ni foam electrodes
nodes.source_text: NN-12 from the scaled-up synthesis procedure was also tested on larger stationary electrodes, where the catalysts are air-brushed onto both sides of 0.3 mm Ni foams... delivering overpotentials of 266 and 272 mV for OER and HER respectively... At 10 and 50 mA cmgeo−2, the cell voltage stabilised at around 1.78 and 2.04 V respectively, with no significant loss of activity after 50 h... faradaic efficiency of 99.5%... OER Tafel slope of 59 mV dec−1... Tafel slope value for HER of 170 mV dec−1.
NN-13 from the 2nd iteration had the overall lowest ηOER at 273.4 mV

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS confirms the predominant presence of Co, Fe, Mo, and O in the NN-12 catalyst with good homogeneity and less than 1.25 at% variation between automated and scaled-up synthesis.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Both energy dispersive X-ray (EDX) ... spectra confirm that NN-12 predominantly comprises of Co, Fe, Mo, and O ... reveal good homogeneity throughout the samples

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS identifies Co(OH)2 (780.4 eV), Fe(III), and Mo(VI) from molybdate. O 1s peaks show lattice hydroxides at 531.1 eV and metal-O species at 529.9 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution XPS scans ... multiplets corresponding to Co(OH)2 observed in the Co 2p at 780.4, 782.2, 786.0, and 790.4 eV ... Fe predominantly exists as Fe(III) ... Mo species as Mo(VI) from the molybdate

nodes.characterization_summary: FTIR-ATR shows hydroxyl stretching (~3370 cm-1) and molybdate features (856 and 926 cm-1). The absence of a 1350 cm-1 peak suggests molybdate intercalation instead of carbonate.
nodes.evidence_snippet: FTIR-ATR spectra ... broad absorption band ... observed around 3370 cm-1 ... bands related to O–Mo–O and M=O at 856 and 926 cm-1 ... peak at ~1350 cm-1 ... is absent.

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman spectra show molybdate bending (328 cm-1), asymmetric stretching (820 cm-1), and symmetric stretching (932 cm-1).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Raman spectra (Fig. S4.5, ESI†) ... strongest features at 328 cm-1, 820 cm-1, and 932 cm-1 assigned to its bending, asymmetric stretching, and symmetric stretching modes

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows poor crystallinity for NN-12 and NiFe. Incorporation of Co, Fe, and Mo disrupts the (00l) stacking, while tungstate incorporation in other samples induces FeOOH precipitation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD patterns ... reflect poor crystallinity ... incorporation of Co, exacerbated by the high Fe content and molybdate incorporation, compromises the crystallinity ... tungstate seems to induce the precipitation of electrically insulating FeOOH phase

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows that NN-12 has a significantly lower charge transfer resistance (Rct) compared to the original NiFe LDH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: NN-12 also exhibits significantly lower charge transfer resistance (Rct) than the original NiFe LDH ... observed from electrochemical impedance spectroscopy

nodes.characterization_summary: Tafel slopes for NN-12 are 59 mV dec−1 for OER (suggesting M*OOH site limitation) and 170 mV dec−1 for HER (suggesting Volmer–Heyrovsky mechanism).
nodes.evidence_snippet: observed OER Tafel slope of 59 mV dec−1 ... Tafel slope value for HER of 170 mV dec−1 ... suggests possible Volmer–Heyrovsky mechanism
